title: Scope of part; limitation on use of genetic testing.
bodyText:
(a) This part shall govern genetic testing of an individual in a proceeding to adjudicate parentage, whether the individual:

(1) Voluntarily submits to testing; or

(2) Is tested under an order of the court or the child support enforcement agency.

(b) Genetic testing shall not be used to:

(1) Challenge the parentage of an individual who is a parent under part VIII or IX; or

(2) Establish the parentage of an individual who is a donor.
bodyHtml:
PART VII.  GENETIC TESTING

 

     [§584A-701]  Scope of part; limitation on use of genetic testing.  (a)  This part shall govern genetic testing of an individual in a proceeding to adjudicate parentage, whether the individual:

     (1)  Voluntarily submits to testing; or

     (2)  Is tested under an order of the court or the child support enforcement agency.

     (b)  Genetic testing shall not be used to:

     (1)  Challenge the parentage of an individual who is a parent under part VIII or IX; or

     (2)  Establish the parentage of an individual who is a donor. [L 2025, c 298, pt of §2]
